sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 11 (City of St. Albans): sec. 9 provides for a Mayor elected by the City's legal voters for a two-year term

City of St. Albans official website, City Clerk page: Nicole Robtoy is the City Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Nicole Robtoy as St. Albans City's City Clerk
